_about: Walter Thomas Prideaux Wolston (1840-1917), Edinburgh physician and Brethren evangelist. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A from the Plymouth Brethren line of Adam's Libronix inventory; Internet Archive OCR, raw; title, edition and date read from each scan's title page or dated preface. No uids minted. All pre-1931, so US public domain.

wolston-another-comforter: Another Comforter: Thirteen Lectures on the Operations of the Holy Ghost (London: James Nisbet; Edinburgh: Gospel Messenger Office, 1892)
wolston-young-men-of-scripture: Young Men of Scripture, 3rd ed. (London: James Nisbet; Edinburgh: Gospel Messenger Office, 1894)
wolston-behold-the-bridegroom: Behold the Bridegroom! Ten Lectures on the Second Coming and Kingdom of the Lord Jesus, 3rd ed. (London: James Nisbet; Edinburgh: Gospel Messenger Office, 1895)
wolston-forty-days: The "Forty Days" of Scripture, 2nd ed. (London: James Nisbet, 1909)
wolston-simon-peter: Simon Peter: His Life and Letters (Edinburgh: Gospel Messenger Office, 1893)
wolston-church-what-is-it: The Church: What Is It? Ten Lectures on the Church of the New Testament (Edinburgh: Gospel Messenger Office; Glasgow and Edinburgh: John Menzies; undated, catalogue date 1924)
